# Information wants to be cheap

> [!summary]
> When copying gets cheaper, the most copied ideas win, not the best ones.

Each drop in the cost of copying (print, the telegraph, the web) moved power from those who control the copies to those who get read.

## My take
The printers were businessmen first: they printed Luther because Luther sold.
